title: Validity of cell sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of eleven registers, let $W\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $t_0,r_{\mathrm{lo}},r_T,r_{\mathrm{hi}}$ be Boolean values. Suppose that $\rho(r_Q)\ge1$ whenever $t_0$ is false and $r_{\mathrm{lo}}$ is true, that $\rho(r_I)\ge1$ whenever $r_{\mathrm{lo}}$ is true, and that $\rho(r_{LB})\ge1$ whenever $t_0$ is false. Then every source in the cell source list of width $W$ determined by these Boolean values is valid for $\rho$.
